sentence_quote: it was open to him to impose an indeterminate sentence particularly in light of the experts’ evidence. This sentence is not demonstrably unfit.

sentence_quote: on Count 8 - 44 months, plus five days jail, less credit for time served of two months and five days, concurrent.
note: Joint submission; concurrent counts; 10-year s. 109 prohibition.

offence_note: Sexual interference and invitation to sexual touching of daughter
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal the sentence but dismiss the sentence appeal.

sentence_quote: In the absence of any s. 12 violation, the trial judge’s proper course in the circumstances was to apply the four‑year minimum sentence.
note: SCC dismisses accused's appeal; four-year mandatory minimum imposed by Court of Appeal stands.

note: Crown appeal about refusal of $4.7M fine dismissed.
